Version 2.0.0 (36)
- A completely rewritten RPGen! New architecture, design cleanup, and more content.
- New feature: Dark mode
- Bug fixes (favoriting bug)

Version 1.0.4 (32) 123123
- New name generators: Yuan-ti, Kobold
- New story generator: Ships
- Add stat blocks to all NPCs
